name: aura-guard-companion
description: Records your editor activity into a local, masked spool (after you consent), lets you log ideas and decisions, adds an @guard chat participant, and turns your day into reviewable ai-log entries.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: SPIL Quality Support Bot runs a local program and reads your git history, so it needs a trusted workspace.

chatParticipants.name: guard
chatParticipants.description: Ask SPIL Quality Support Bot about how Aura is built and why

auraGuard.guardHome.markdownDescription: Folder of your own SPIL Quality Support Bot clone (must contain `engine/src/cli/main.ts`). Required.

auraGuard.nodePath.description: Path to node (24 or newer). Empty means `node` from PATH.

auraGuard.spoolDir.markdownDescription: Local folder for captured events. Empty means the env var `AURA_GUARD_SPOOL`, else `~/.aura-guard/spool`. Network paths are refused.

auraGuard.workspaces.description: Absolute paths of workspaces to capture even if they have no ai-log/README.md.

auraGuard.developerName.description: Your first name, lower case. Empty means the first word of `git config user.name`.

auraGuard.capture.commits.description: Capture git commits (subject, body, file names with line counts).

auraGuard.capture.saves.description: Capture file saves as counts per file per 5 minutes. Never contents.

auraGuard.capture.tasks.description: Capture task names, exit codes and duration.

auraGuard.capture.terminal.description: Capture allow-listed terminal commands (masked), never their output.

auraGuard.capture.diagnostics.description: Capture error and warning counts when a commit is detected.
